subject.title: feat(webui): redesign tool-call rendering with inline diffs, group summaries, and cheap-model purpose titles

question: Should decorative tool titles permit an explicitly configured utility model across providers, while limiting the implicit Luna fallback to sessions whose effective model is OpenAI?
rationale: This display-only feature spends model tokens and transmits transcript-derived tool inputs, so the allowed cross-provider behavior requires explicit maintainer intent beyond the mechanical routing fix.

options.title: Gate implicit fallback by session
options.body: Allow explicitly configured utility models, but permit implicit Luna only when the loaded session's effective model routes to OpenAI.

options.title: Require explicit utility configuration
options.body: Remove implicit Luna and generate titles only when the operator has configured a utility model.

options.title: Defer model-generated titles
options.body: Land deterministic rendering and pairing while moving AI purpose titles to a later product-approved change.

recommendation.title: Gate implicit fallback by session
recommendation.body: Allow explicitly configured utility models, but permit implicit Luna only when the loaded session's effective model routes to OpenAI.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-based owner for the current Control UI chat surface and is assigned to this feature.
